sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Thorndyke's
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 索恩迪克公司。

sentences.en: EDITH: Good morning
sentences.zh: EDITH: 早上好。

sentences.en: Is that Mr Thorndyke?
sentences.zh: 是索恩迪克先生吗？

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Speaking
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 我就是。

sentences.en: How can I help?
sentences.zh: 有什么可以帮您的？

sentences.en: EDITH: I've got quite a few things which need painting and fixing in the flat and wonder whether you'd be able to do the work
sentences.zh: EDITH: 我公寓里有不少东西需要粉刷和维修，不知您是否能承接这项工作。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: I'm sure I'd be able to help but let me take down a few details
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 我相信我可以帮忙，不过请允许我先记下一些细节。

sentences.en: EDITH: Yes, of course
sentences.zh: EDITH: 好的，当然可以。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Well, firstly, how did you hear about us?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 首先，您是怎么知道我们公司的？

sentences.en: EDITH: It was my friend May Hampton ... you did some excellent work for her a couple of years ago
sentences.zh: EDITH: 是我的朋友梅·汉普顿介绍的……几年前您曾为她做过非常出色的工作。

sentences.en: Do you remember?
sentences.zh: 您还记得吗？

sentences.en: Example
sentences.zh: 示例

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Oh, yes, that was in West Park Flats, lovely lady
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 哦，对，那是在西公园公寓，一位非常可爱的女士。

sentences.en: EDITH: Yes, she is
sentences.zh: EDITH: 是的，她的确如此。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: And what's your name, please?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 请问您的姓名是？

sentences.en: EDITH: It's Edith Pargetter
sentences.zh: EDITH: 埃迪丝·帕吉特。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Edith can you spell your surname, please?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 埃迪丝，请问您的姓氏怎么拼写？

sentences.en: EDITH: It's P-A-R-G-E-doubleT-E-R
sentences.zh: EDITH: P-A-R-G-E-双T-E-R。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Double T, right
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 双T，明白了。

sentences.en: And do you live in West Park Flats as well?
sentences.zh: 您也住在西公园公寓吗？

sentences.en: EDITH: No, actually it's East Park, Flat 4
sentences.zh: EDITH: 不，实际上我住在东公园公寓，4号公寓。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Oh, right, that's over the road, seem to remember - quite difficult to get to
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 哦，明白了，就在马路对面，我记得那里似乎不太好进。

sentences.en: EDITH: Yes, it's at the back of the library
sentences.zh: EDITH: 是的，就在图书馆后面。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Right, I know
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 明白了，我知道那个地方。

sentences.en: And what's your phone number?
sentences.zh: 您的电话号码是多少？

sentences.en: EDITH: 875934 but I'm out a great deal in the afternoons and evenings
sentences.zh: EDITH: 875934，但我下午和晚上经常外出。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: So would the best time to ring you be in the morning?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 那么，给您打电话的最佳时间是在上午吗？

sentences.en: EDITH: Yes
sentences.zh: EDITH: 是的。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Fine
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 好的。

sentences.en: I've made a note of that
sentences.zh: 我已经记下了。

sentences.en: Can I just ask, I'll be in a van and know parking's rather difficult round your flats
sentences.zh: 我想再确认一下：我会开车过来，而您那片公寓楼附近停车似乎比较困难。

sentences.en: Where would you recommend?
sentences.zh: 您推荐停在哪里呢？

sentences.en: EDITH: Well, I always tell people in larger vehicles to park by the postbox on the 05 other side of the road from the entrance
sentences.zh: EDITH: 嗯，我通常告诉开大型车辆的人把车停在入口马路对面的邮筒旁边。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Good, thanks
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 好的，谢谢。

sentences.en: EDITH: And will you be able to give me a full itemised quote?
sentences.zh: EDITH: 您能给我一份详尽的分项报价单吗？

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Oh, yes, I'll list all the jobs separately with individual prices
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 哦，当然可以，我会将所有项目分别列出，并注明各自的价格。

sentences.en: EDITH: That'd be a great help
sentences.zh: EDITH: 这会对我帮助很大。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: No problem
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 没问题。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Now, what would you like me to do?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 那么，您希望我做些什么呢？

sentences.en: EDITH: Firstly and most urgently is in the kitchen
sentences.zh: EDITH: 首先，也是最紧急的，是厨房的问题。

sentences.en: With all the weather damage, the glass in the door has cracked and I'd need that fixing
sentences.zh: 由于天气造成的损坏，门上的玻璃已经裂开了，我需要尽快修复……

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: I presume you mean replacing?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 我猜您的意思是更换？

sentences.en: EDITH: Oh, yes
sentences.zh: EDITH: 哦，是的。

sentences.en: And as soon as possible
sentences.zh: 而且越快越好。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: What I'll do is come round tomorrow morning and do that immediately
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 我明天上午就过去，马上处理这件事。

sentences.en: EDITH: Thank you so much
sentences.zh: EDITH: 非常感谢！

sentences.en: The other things aren't so urgent but
sentences.zh: 其他几件事没那么紧急，但……

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Now, I'll make a note of everything you want doing
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 好的，我会把您所有需要做的事项都记下来。

sentences.en: EDITH: Well, in the kitchen I'd like some painting doing
sentences.zh: EDITH: 嗯，在厨房里，我想粉刷一下。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: All the kitchen walls?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 整个厨房的墙面都要粉刷吗？

sentences.en: EDITH: Just the area over the cooker
sentences.zh: EDITH: 只需灶台上方那块区域。

sentences.en: It's very greasy
sentences.zh: 那里非常油腻……

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Right ... it does tend to get that way!
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 明白了……那里确实容易变成那样！

sentences.en: EDITH: Yes!
sentences.zh: EDITH: 没错！

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Well, if you want a proper job done what I'd need to do is strip the old paint and plaster it about a week before I paint it
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 好吧，如果您希望施工质量达标，我需要先铲除旧漆，再进行抹灰处理，这大约需要一周时间，之后才能开始粉刷。

sentences.en: EDITH: Of course
sentences.zh: EDITH: 当然可以。

sentences.en: Now, May tells me you also do work in the garden
sentences.zh: 对了，梅告诉我，您也在花园里做活儿。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: That's right
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 没错。

sentences.en: EDITH: Well, I'd like you to replace a fence
sentences.zh: EDITH: 那么，我想请您更换一道围栏。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Just one?
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 就一道？

sentences.en: EDITH: Yes, at the far end
sentences.zh: EDITH: 是的，在最远的那一端。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Fine
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 好的。

sentences.en: Shouldn't be a problem
sentences.zh: 应该没什么问题。

sentences.en: EDITH: And that's the lot
sentences.zh: EDITH: 就这些了。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: Fine
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 好的。

sentences.en: Yeah, as I say I can come round tomorrow morning to look over things with you
sentences.zh: 嗯，正如我刚才所说，我明天上午可以过来，和您一起查看所有事项。

sentences.en: EDITH: That's great, thank you
sentences.zh: EDITH: 太好了，谢谢您。

sentences.en: MR THORNDYKE: So, I'll look forward to seeing you tomorrow at
sentences.zh: MR THORNDYKE: 那么，我期待明天……
